title: Aligning Large Language Models with Human: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying literature that repeats the LLM evaluation process multiple times with different candidate ordering to reveal and calibrate the tendency of LLM evaluators to assign higher scores to the first-appearing candidates.
Reviewing studies demonstrating that LLM-based evaluators systematically prefer longer responses, sometimes favoring them even over shorter candidates that lack factual or grammatical errors.
Surveying findings that show LLM evaluators tend to favor and assign higher scores to their own generated responses compared to responses produced by other sources or models.
